N.K.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
S. 2. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date October 30, 1936.

Subject Korean named Kim To-Han, alias Kim Jo-Ko, alias Kim Tetsu-Gen,
alias Kim Ko-Zen.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

With reference to the attached cutting from the North-
China Daily News published on October 28, 1936, I have to state
that the local Japanese Consular Police have given the following
information regarding a Korean named Kim To-Han:-

Kim To-Han(金東範), alias Kim Jo-Ko(金汝洪), alias
Kim Tetsu-Gen(金鐵涼), alias Kim Ko-Zen(金浩然), aged 42,
residing at No. 1 Pao Shun Li(宝顺里), Chungchow Road
(中州路), Chapel, was arrested at No. 139 Race Course Road
on October 8, when a narcotic raid was carried out by members
of the Japanese Consular Police and the Shanghai Municipal
Police. At the time of the raid, Kim To-Han was at No. 139
Race Course Road and was arrested on suspicion of dealing in
narcotics.

As the result of an investigation made by the Japanese
Consular Police, it was ascertained that Kim was formerly a
village master in Korea. Whilst in that position, he mis-
appropriated a sum of Yen 3,000.00 from public funds and
arrived in Shanghai in March, 1924. Shortly after his
arrival in Shanghai he was connected with the Korean Independence
movement and was appointed Secretary to An Sho-Ko(安昌浩), then
the Home Minister of the Korean Provisional Government, which
was established in Shanghai in 1919. Kim, however, severed
his connection with the Independence Movement towards the end
of 1925, since then he has been peddling ginseng in various
parts of China. He has been detained in the Japanese Consulate,
pending further investigation.

D. Kamashita
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ____
S. 2. 特别支部警署，
报告
日期：1936年10月30日。

事由：朝鲜人金东範（Kim To-Han），化名金汝洪（Kim Jo-Ko），化名金铁凉（Kim Tetsu-Gen），化名金浩然（Kim Ko-Zen）。

制作人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：**〔此处转录不清〕**

关于附上的1936年10月28日出版的《字林西报》剪报，本人须陈述，日本驻沪领事馆警察就一名名为金东範的朝鲜人提供了如下信息：

金东範（金東範），化名金汝洪（金汝洪），化名金铁凉（金鐵涼），化名金浩然（金浩然），42岁，住中州路（Chungchow Road）宝顺里（Pao Shun Li）1号，于10月8日在跑马厅路（Race Course Road）139号被捕，当时日本驻沪领事馆警察与上海公共租界工部局警务处人员正在执行一次毒品突击搜查行动。在搜查时，金东範身处跑马厅路139号，因涉嫌贩卖毒品而被捕。

经日本驻沪领事馆警察调查，查明金氏此前曾在朝鲜担任里长。在该职位期间，他侵吞公款3,000日元，并于1924年3月抵达上海。抵沪后不久，他便与朝鲜独立运动发生联系，并被任命为安昌浩（An Sho-Ko）的秘书，安氏时任1919年在上海成立的朝鲜临时政府内务部长。然而，金氏于1925年底断绝了与独立运动的联系，此后一直在中国各地兜售人参。目前他已被拘留在日本领事馆，以待进一步调查。

D. Kamashita
D. S.

特别支部副督察长。

（左侧页边批注及印章：）
FM 2
Gt 40,000

October 27, 1936. Morning Translation.

KAINICHI

JAPANESE COUNTERFEIT SILVER COINS.

The other day a number of
Japanese counterfeit silver coins were detected by the
Nishiyama Brothers' Company, Woosung Road. Since then
the Japanese Consular Police and the Municipal Police
have been making an investigation.
It is now reported that three
men named Miyake, Takahira and Murono have been arrested
at Osaka and a trunk full of counterfeit coins was found
at the home of Takahira. The men admitted having obtained the
counterfeit coins in Shanghai. The Police are endeavouring
to trace the counterfeiters in Shanghai.

NICHI NICHI

ARREST OF KIM TO HAN, KOREAN RADICAL.

Taking advantage of the strained
Sino-Japanese relations, Korean radicals seem to have
recommenced their activities. On October 24, members
of the Second Section of the Japanese Consular Police
effected the arrest of a Korean named Kim To Han at a
certain place in Shanghai. He is regarded as a prominent
member of the XX Party.

1936年10月27日。晨间译稿。

《每日新闻》（KAINICHI）

日本伪造银币。

日前，吴淞路西山兄弟公司（Nishiyama Brothers' Company）查获若干日本伪造银币。此后，日本驻沪领事馆警察与工部局警务处一直在进行调查。
现据报道，三名名为三宅（Miyake）、高平（Takahira）和村野（Murono）的男子已在大阪被捕，并在高平家中发现一箱装满伪造硬币的行李箱。这些人承认是在上海获得这些伪造硬币的。警方正努力追查在上海的伪造者。

《日日新闻》（NICHI NICHI）

朝鲜激进分子金东範被捕。

利用中日关系紧张之机，朝鲜激进分子似乎已重新开始活动。10月24日，日本驻沪领事馆警察第二课成员在上海某地逮捕了一名名为金东範（Kim To Han）的朝鲜人。他被视为XX党的重要成员。
